title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially graduated from beta, bringing its powerful capabilities to all users.

title: Powerful File & Media Management
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded files, allowing you to easily manage, upload, and tailor their appearance within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand-new public roadmap page, offering complete transparency into our progress, upcoming features, and exciting long-term vision for the product.

title: Sleeker, Smarter Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all while updating their look to seamlessly integrate with our modern interface.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Our latest update delivers a significantly smoother and more intuitive collaborative editing experience, empowering teams to work together with greater ease.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and access all relevant content shared by your connections, making collaboration more intuitive and productive.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to offer comprehensive support for multiple languages, making our platform truly accessible to a worldwide audience.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map
summary: Uncover insights and streamline your workflow with powerful new filtering options and enhanced social visibility in your personalized knowledge constellation.

title: Master Your Knowledge: Advanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: This update empowers you to quickly narrow down your knowledge base using advanced filtering by tags and custom date ranges, and save your refined searches as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Flexible Note Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive and personalized way to organize and display your connected notes with flexible viewing options.

title: Noeko: Your Platform, Your Choice - Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Prepare for the official release of Noeko, offering versatile self-hosting options and tailored paid plans designed to give you greater control and flexibility over your data and collaboration.

title: Expanded & Enhanced Theme Collection
summary: Elevate your experience with a vibrant array of beautifully designed themes and significant improvements to existing favorites, offering more personalization options than ever before.

title: Smarter Homepage Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience by ensuring the homepage always greets you with the perfect message that accurately reflects the time of day, making your visits more intuitive and personal.

title: Effortless Item Management in Lists
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by performing quick actions like unapplying tags or deleting items directly from any list view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Integrate More of Your World's Information
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a broader spectrum of information sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, directly within your workspace for comprehensive knowledge building.
